queer_characters.name: Andrew Beckett
queer_characters.notes: Protagonist explicitly identified as a gay attorney living with AIDS who conceals both from his firm; landmark 1993 mainstream depiction of an LGBTQ character facing discrimination, though his arc ends in death.

queer_characters.name: Miguel Alvarez
queer_characters.notes: Described in source as Beckett's partner but a minor presence with little developed characterization.

contributor_notes: Source text confirms Beckett as gay and living with AIDS; he dies shortly after the verdict, supporting bury-your-gays and tragic-queer readings, though the film is noted as a watershed mainstream LGBTQ/AIDS depiction (hence historical-context rep_quality). Miguel Alvarez is only briefly mentioned. No subtitle, audio, or creator-identity information provided in source. Maintainer should verify creator credits and any additional character details.
